index.title: Ama-glaze adumile
index.lead: Ama-glaze aziwa emhlabeni wonke, ngalinye lenziwe ngokokwakha kwendabuko kwendawo yalo, ne-UMF yalo nohlobo olwenziwe ngokokwakha okuthengiswa lapho ukhona.
index.more: Ama-glaze amaningi ayeza: ngalinye lingezwa uma iresiphi yalo nokokwakha kwalo kusekelwe okungenani yimithombo emithathu efundiwe.

glaze.lead: I-glaze edumile ({native}): iresiphi yayo yendabuko noma ukuhlaziywa, ukushisa kwayo, nohlobo olwenziwe ngokokwakha okuthengiswa lapho ukhona.
glaze.historyOnly: Umlando kuphela: le glaze yayenziwe ngomthofu (lead, Pb). Ukuhlaziywa kwayo kuboniswa njengomlando, hhayi njengeresiphi yokuxuba. Uhlobo olungezansi luyi-glaze ehlukile, engenamthofu.

local.heading: Ngokokwakha kwendawo yakho
local.intro: I-UMF yeresiphi yendabuko, yenziwe ngokokwakha okujwayelekile okuthengiswa lapho uthenga khona. Khetha lapho uthenga khona ukuze uyibone.
local.testFirst: Shisa ama-test tile ngaphambi kokuthi uyisebenzise kunoma yisiphi isitsha, futhi uhlole indawo ethinta ukudla ukuthi ayiphumi yini izinsimbi (leaching).
local.untestedNote: Kubaliwe, akukashiswa ukuhlolwa: shisa ama-test tile ngaphambi kokuyisebenzisa.
local.poor: Lokhu okokwakha akukwazi ukusondela kufomula okuhloswe yona.
local.choose: Khetha lapho uthenga khona okokwakha ukuze uyibone yenziwe ngalokho okuthengiswa lapho.
